stew.definition:
n. food prepared by stewing especially meat or fish with vegetables
v. bear a grudge; harbor ill feelings
v. cook slowly and for a long time in liquid
stew.translation:
n. 炖, 烦恼, 热浴, 妓院, 鱼塘
vi. 炖, 焖, 忧虑
vt. 炖, 焖, 使焦虑

stew meat.translation: [网络] 炖肉；红肉；半磅牛肉块

steward.definition:
n. someone who manages property or other affairs for someone else
n. the ship's officer who is in charge of provisions and dining arrangements
n. an attendant on an airplane
steward.translation:
n. 管理人, 招待员, 管家, 乘务员
[经] 轮船, 飞机的服务员, (财务)管理员

stewarded.definition:
past tense of steward
n. someone who manages property or other affairs for someone else
n. the ship's officer who is in charge of provisions and dining arrangements
n. an attendant on an airplane
stewarded.translation:
(steward 的过去时) n. 管理人, 招待员, 管家, 乘务员
[经] 轮船, 飞机的服务员, (财务)管理员

stewardess.definition: n. a woman steward on an airplane
stewardess.translation: n. 空中小姐, 女管理人, 女管家

stewardesses.definition: n. a woman steward on an airplane
stewardesses.translation: n. （飞机上的）女服务员, 空中小姐( stewardess的复数形式 )

stewarding.definition:
-ing form of steward
n. someone who manages property or other affairs for someone else
n. the ship's officer who is in charge of provisions and dining arrangements

(steward 的现在分词) n. 管理人, 招待员, 管家, 乘务员
[经] 轮船, 飞机的服务员, (财务)管理员

stewards.definition:
n. someone who manages property or other affairs for someone else
n. the ship's officer who is in charge of provisions and dining arrangements
n. an attendant on an airplane
stewards.translation: n. （轮船、飞机等的）乘务员( steward的复数形式 ); （俱乐部、旅馆、工会等的）管理员; （大型活动的）组织者; （私人家中的）管家

stewardship.translation: n. steward的职务, 管理工作

stewardships.definition:
plural of stewardship
n. the position of steward
stewardships.translation: (stewardship 的复数) n. steward的职务, 管理工作

stewardson.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 斯图尔森取自父名，来源于Steward,含义是“斯图尔德之子”(son of Steward)

stewart.definition:
n. United States film actor who portrayed incorruptible but modest heros (1908-1997)
n. Scottish philosopher and follower of Thomas Reid (1753-1828)

stewart island.translation: 斯图尔特岛(新西兰岛屿)

stewart principle.translation: [医] 斯图尔特氏原理(测定器官总血流量)

stewart's purple.translation: [医] 斯图尔特氏紫(碘溶于凡士林中)

stewart's solution.translation: [医] 斯图尔特氏溶液(一种防腐液)

stewart's test.translation: [医] 斯图尔特氏试验(检侧支循环)

stewart's vein fluid.translation: [医] 斯图尔特氏曲张静脉硬化液

stewart-holmes sign.translation: [医] 斯-霍二氏征(回缩现象)

stewart-morel syndrome.translation: [医] 斯-莫二氏综合征, 莫雷耳氏综合征

stewed.definition:

stewed.translation: a. 炖煮的, (非正式)喝醉酒的

stewing.definition: n. an extreme state of worry and agitation
stewing.translation: [机] 保温净化, 焖热, 烧透, 均热

stewpan.definition: n a saucepan used for stewing

stewpot.definition: n. A pot used for stewing.
